setup_commands: yarn install
npm install -g yarn
apt-get update && apt-get install -y nodejs npm
npm install -g yarn
yarn install
cat package.json
yarn test
yarn test:jest
cat /tmp/flow/zStestbed.log
cat package.json
ls -l test
cat katex-spec.js
ls -l test
yarn test:jest
cat test/setup.js
cat package.json | grep jest
echo '{ "jest": { "testTimeout": 30000 } }' >> package.json
yarn test
jq '.jest += {"testTimeout": 30000}' package.json > tmp.json && mv tmp.json package.json
nano package.json
